question: Which genre has the most tracks?
generated_sql: SELECT T2.Name FROM Track AS T1 INNER JOIN Genre AS T2 ON T1.GenreId = T2.GenreId GROUP BY T1.GenreId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which 5 artists have the most albums?
generated_sql:
SELECT T1.Name, COUNT(T2.AlbumId) AS AlbumCount
FROM Artist AS T1
JOIN Album AS T2 ON T1.ArtistId = T2.ArtistId
GROUP BY T1.ArtistId, T1.Name
ORDER BY AlbumCount DESC
LIMIT 5
